subject: Live run: evan_hubinger agentic loop (paid, nqiu07 Modal + Nathan's Tinker)
body: Running from a frozen snapshot worktree at 3456cd48 (runs/snapshots/loop-evan-3456cd48), so edits to autoresearch/ on main don't affect it and I'm not locking autoresearch. Uses Modal app autoresearch-auditor in workspace nqiu07 and the Tinker proxy on 127.0.0.1:8100: please don't stop either. Also new on main (3456cd48): research --parallel-evals measures an iteration's candidates concurrently (same sample ids, same results, less wall time), and PetriMeasurer prepares seed rewrites concurrently. Results go to results/e3b/loop_evan_hubinger_*.
